data-aid="CONTENT_MEDIA_HEADLINE1_RENDERED">Bar al Hikman</h4><div data-ux="ContentText" alignment="center" data-aid="CONTENT_MEDIA_DESCRIPTION1_RENDERED"><p style="margin:0"><span>We bring you to Bar al Hikman, a flat water spot surrounded by crystal clear waters with flamingos and coral reefs for snorkeling. Because of the wind coming from the cool ocean the temperatures here are on average a perfect 29° during the day and 25° at night. With steady wind blowing between 20-35 knots. Making it a perfect uncrowded place to learn kitesurfing, &nbsp;new tricks and work on your wakestyle skills.</span></p><p style="margin:0"><span>Bar al Hikman is a 5 hour drive from Muscat airport and a 3 hour drive from Duqm airport.</span></p></div></div></div></div></div></section>  </div></div></div><div id="2d1a4bed-e517-4529-85c5-64c81c956698"><div data-ux="Widget" role="region" id="2d1a4bed-e517-4529-85c5-64c81c956698"><div> <section data-ux="Section"><div data-ux="Container"><div data-ux="Block"><div data-ux="Video"><div data-ux="Block"><div data-ux="EmbedContainer"><iframe data-ux="Embed" allowfullscreen="" type="text/html" frameBorder="0" src="https://youtube.com/embed/zRECJPzkRKU?rel=0&amp;showinfo=0&amp;start=0&amp;autoplay=0&amp;loop=0&amp;muted=0&amp;controls=1" data-aid="CONTENT_VIDEO_RENDERED"></iframe></div></div></div></div><div data-ux="Grid"><div data-ux="GridCell"><div data-ux="ContentBasic"><h4 role="heading" aria-level="4" data-ux="ContentHeading" data-aid="CONTENT_MEDIA_HEADLINE1_RENDERED">Shrimpies</h4><div data-ux="ContentText" alignment="center" data-aid="CONTENT_MEDIA_DESCRIPTION1_RENDERED"><p style="margin:0"><span>Introducing Shrimpies, a secret spot with beautiful waves 2 hours south of Bar al Hikman, perfect for surfing, wave kiting, twintip kiting and SUP-Ing. The spot is surrounded by pristine white sand dunes.</span></p><p style="margin:0"><span>Shrimpies is a 5 hour drive from Muscat airport and a 2 hour drive from Duqm airport.</span></p></div></div></div></div></div></section>  </div></div></div><div id="07435646-1f76-47df-938c-db098bd52179"><div data-ux="Widget" role="region" id="07435646-1f76-47df-938c-db098bd52179"><div> <section data-ux="Section"><div data-ux="Container"><div data-ux="Block"><div data-ux="Video"><div data-ux="Block"><div data-ux="EmbedContainer"><iframe data-ux="Embed" allowfullscreen="" type="text/html" frameBorder="0" src="https://youtube.com/embed/kdrwhQnv_aQ?rel=0&amp;showinfo=0&amp;start=0&amp;autoplay=0&amp;loop=0&amp;muted=0&amp;controls=1" data-aid="CONTENT_VIDEO_RENDERED"></iframe></div></div></div></div><div data-ux="Grid"><div data-ux="GridCell"><div data-ux="ContentBasic"><h4 role="heading" aria-level="4" data-ux="ContentHeading" data-aid="CONTENT_MEDIA_HEADLINE1_RENDERED">The hidden lagoon</h4><div data-ux="ContentText" alignment="center" data-aid="CONTENT_MEDIA_DESCRIPTION1_RENDERED"><p style="margin:0"><span>&nbsp;&nbsp;</span></p><p style="margin:0"><span>The hidden lagoon, a big flatwater lagoon in the far south of Oman. We recently discovered this lagoon and are adding it to our camp destinations. The chances of finding someone else kitesurfing here are almost zero.</span></p><p style="margin:0"><span>The hidden lagoon is a 7 and a half hour drive from Muscat airport and a 2 hour drive from Duqm airport.</span></p></div></div></div></div></div></section>  </div></div></div><div id="ff0516c7-7278-4b75-a7a2-b4da15f09d3e"><div data-ux="Widget" role="region" id="ff0516c7-7278-4b75-a7a2-b4da15f09d3e"><div> <section data-ux="Section"><div data-ux="Container"><h2 role="heading" aria-level="2" data-ux="SectionHeading" data-aid="CONTENT_SECTION_TITLE_RENDERED"><span data-ux="Element">Camp schedule</span><div data-ux="Block"><hr aria-hidden="true" role="separator" data-ux="SectionHeadingHR"/></div></h2><div data-ux="ContentCards"><div data-ux="GridCell"><div data-ux="ContentCard"><div data-ux="ContentCardText" data-aid="CONTENT_DESCRIPTION1_RENDERED" fontScaleMultiplier="1.26" data-font-scaled="true"><p style="margin:0"><span><br></span></p><p style="margin:0"><span><u><strong>Windy Season May till September</strong></u></span></p><p style="margin:0"><span>Special rates, locations and dates for groups on request</span></p></div></div></div></div></div></section>  </div></div></div><div id="7a2025f4-aa4a-47b3-9ac8-4d7dfc6ca775"><div data-ux="Widget" role="region" id="7a2025f4-aa4a-47b3-9ac8-4d7dfc6ca775"><div> <section data-ux="Section"><div data-ux="Container"><h2 role="heading" aria-level="2" data-ux="SectionHeading" data-aid="MENU_SECTION_TITLE_RENDERED"><span data-ux="Element">Price list</span><div data-ux="Block"><hr aria-hidden="true" role="separator" data-ux="SectionHeadingHR"/></div></h2><div data-ux="Grid"><div data-ux="GridCell"><div data-ux="Menu"><div data-ux="Block" data-aid="MENU_CATEGORY_KITESURFCA"><div data-ux="Block"><div data-ux="Block"><div data-ux="Grid"><div data-ux="GridCell"><h3 role="heading" aria-level="3" data-ux="HeadingMiddle" data-aid="MENU_SECTION_TITLE_0">Kitesurf Camps -
